#  13035 - Selected Topics in Quantum Theory I Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13035 - module is no longer offered from SS 2023**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Selected Topics in Quantum Theory I**  |  
|  Ausgewählte Kapitel der Quantentheorie I   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Bestehorn, Michael 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Each winter semester even year   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | After successfully completing the module, students have gained a broader understanding of quantum theory. Analysing concrete examples, the module provided methods of gaining knowledge, establishing a methodology, theory development, classification of physical findings etc.. Furthermore, the student's social skills such as the ability to cooperate and other individual skills such as diligence, perseverance, curiosity, initiative, etc. have been supported.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Concept of states, pure states, mixed states, density matrix, coherent states
  * Functional integral formulation of quantum theory
  * Information, teleportation, quantum information

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | 
  * Knowledge of quantum mechanics in the frame of bachelor studies.

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * D. Bohm: Quantum Theory
  * W. Greiner, B. Müller: Quantum Mechanics - Symmetries
  * W. Greiner: Relativistic Quantum Mechanics
  * D. Bruß: Quantum Information
  * U. Mosel, Path Integrals in Field Theory

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Oral examination, 30-45 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Physics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Physical Specialization with Theoretical Focus“, topic area „Theory, Simulation and further topics“
  * Study programme Applied Mathematics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Anwendungen“, field „Physik“

Self-organized studies are composed of: 
  * Reworking of the lecture and
  * preparation of demonstrations as well as exercises.

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecture: Selected Topics of Quantum Theory I (2 Hours per Week per Semester)
  * Accompanying exercises (2 Hours per Week per Semester)
  * Related examination

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 10.01.2023 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
